meta.title: Trust in political parties
meta.question: How much do Poles trust political parties?
meta.measure: Average trust in political parties, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in political parties, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.notes: CDCEE, January 1991 and March 2000. 'Totally / to a certain point / little / not at all'.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in political parties?
items.notes: WVS Poland, 1997, 2005, 2012 (3 surveys; not asked in 1989). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: To what degree do you trust political parties? (1 complete trust ... 5 complete lack of trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2000-11 (APiW 126), 1 survey. 'Do jakiego stopnia darzy Pan(i) zaufaniem', 1 = complete trust ... 5 = complete lack of trust.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust political parties?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2001.1, 2002.2, 2003.2, 2003.4, 2004.1 (5 surveys). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust'.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust political parties? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (8 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March).

items.wording: To what degree do political parties inspire your trust? (1 no trust ... 7 great trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-09 (APiW 148), 1 survey. 1 = no trust ... 7 = great trust.

items.wording: Do you trust political parties? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2004-09, 2006-12 (2 surveys). One-off CBOS trust questions answered 'zdecydowanie tak ... zdecydowanie nie' (not the 'mam zaufanie' battery).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust political parties?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2026, 42 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale. '$' keeps out the Turkish Cypriot copy '(TCC)' asked in the same files.

items.wording: Trust in political parties (0 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust)
items.notes: ESS Poland, rounds 2-11 (2004-2023), 10 surveys; not asked in round 1. Round 10 (2021-22) was self-completion; the pipeline's MODE_SPLITS makes it a question of its own.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in political parties?
items.notes: EVS, 2008, 2017 (2 surveys; not asked in 1990 or 1999). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: To what extent do you trust political parties? (very high ... very low)
items.notes: POLPAN 2013 (E05) and 2018 (E02), 2 waves; 1 = very high ... 5 = very low (or no) trust. The 2013 duplicate in the P3 supplement (UZP3*, reversed scale, about 500 respondents) is deliberately not matched. POLPAN is a panel with refreshment samples.

items.wording: Trust in political parties (0 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust political parties? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.
PGSW 2023. 'Trust very much / rather trust / rather distrust / completely distrust'.
